title: Mistral AI releases Timestral time-series foundation models
excerpt: The new family of models provides probabilistic, multivariate forecasting and supports four sizes ranging from 5M to 209M parameters.
bodyHtml:
Mistral AI announced the release of Timestral on October 15, 2026, a new family of foundation models designed for time-series data. The models are capable of delivering probabilistic, multivariate forecasts and are available in four sizes, ranging from 5M to 209M parameters.

According to Mistral AI, the 209M parameter model ranks first on the GIFT-Eval, TIME, and fev-bench public benchmarks. The models are designed to run on standard server CPUs without requiring a GPU for inference. The architecture supports a context length of 32,768 time steps.

The company has published a GitHub repository to allow users to run the models on their own data. For further adaptation, the models are available through Mistral Forge, which supports fine-tuning on proprietary data and architectural extensions.
